name: mod-menu
description: Owns /mod-menu, which hides or shows the panel pills above the prompt; each panel mod draws its own entry there

labels.title: Menu labels
labels.description: When pills show their names. auto draws icon and name, and drops every pill to its icon when the row is wider than the window. always keeps the names. never shows icons alone. Icons alone need Nerd Font icons, since safe mode has none. /mod-menu labels auto|always|never sets it too
